info.title: angular_v2
info.description: PLACEHOLDER — a committed stand-in for the contract PostgREST generates from the live database. It has no paths because the template has no tables yet; the baseline migration lands in P1-N2. The real file is produced by the chain documented in README.md: PostgREST serves Swagger 2.0 at GET /, swagger2openapi converts it to OpenAPI 3.0, and that output replaces this file. The Angular types are generated from it with `npm run generate:client` in frontend/.
